quotes.author: Carly Dilday
quotes.text: Our overnight adventure to Bear Glacier with Adventure 60 North was nothing short of amazing! It’s hard to pick a favorite part — the helicopter ride in was absolutely breathtaking, and kayaking through massive icebergs felt like something out of a dream. Spending the night out there made it even more special. The stillness, the views, and just being surrounded by such raw beauty was unforgettable. Our guide, Stu, was knowledgeable, fun, and made the whole experience feel both safe and enriching. This was truly a once-in-a-lifetime kind of trip that we’ll carry with us forever. Highly, highly recommend Adventure 60 North for anyone looking to do something extraordinary.

quotes.author: Jo Beth Bootz
quotes.text: We had the BEST time tandem kayaking as a family in Seward, Alaska! The views were absolutely breathtaking—mountains, wildlife, and that crisp Alaskan air. What made it even more special was our guide, Morgan. She was friendly, knowledgeable, and made sure everyone felt safe and had fun. We laughed a lot, learned so much about the area, and made some unforgettable memories on the water. Highly recommend this experience for anyone visiting Seward. Thank you, Morgan, for such a fantastic adventure! Highly recommend this company. We had a perfect day with magical experiences our kids will never forget.

quotes.author: Summer Clark
quotes.text: Kelli was the BEST guide. If you are thinking about booking an activity, I 100% recommend Kelli. We paddled to Bridal Veil Falls and it was truly one of the best experiences. Her knowledge on Alaska is very impressive and her kindness is unforgettable. She has an incredible way of making you feel safe and at ease. Additionally, the entire staff was great! They are all very professional and organized. They all care deeply about creating a meaningful experience for every guest.

quotes.author: Jerel McDonald
quotes.text: We did the shore fishing and even though it wasn’t the best time for salmon we still caught fish. Doug helped us out, checked on us until we had the technique down and put us in the right places. I was really happy to see my son catch some large salmon. Afterward Doug cleaned and filleted them for us and told us exactly how to get them home.

quotes.author: Moe Bock
quotes.text: Adventure 60 North gave us an unforgettable day at Exit Glacier! They picked us up right in Seward and took care of everything. The guide was knowledgeable and made the hike both fun and informative. Couldn’t have asked for a better way to experience the glacier!
